text:
vikram: hey all, vikram here - first day! quick onboarding snag: okta login fine but when i try to open apps it says 'Access blocked: device attestation required', google drive manager link shows 403, 1Password invite link expired, and trying to register a security key (YubiKey) returns 'Device attestation failed'. who do i poke? :wave:
it-support: welcome vikram! can you confirm you signed in with your corporate email and that your device is enrolled in MDM? also which OS/browser?
vikram: yes vikram@redwood.com. MacBook Pro macOS 13.5, Chrome 115. Jamf shows 'Not Enrolled' even though the device was imaged.
onboarding-bot: Welcome! Typical flow: Okta -> SCIM -> MDM enrollment -> device attestation -> apps/1Password. If any step stalls tag @it-support and @idp. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/device-attestation :book:
idp: tagging in. quick check: i see your Okta user, but groupsync completed before MDM completed so device attestation policy blocked app access. also there's a stale alias vikram.work@gmail.com linked which may be causing the 1Password token mismatch. i'll remove alias and re-run provisioning.
emily-manager: i re-shared the project drive and added vikram directly; please refresh once idp confirms.
it-support: for Jamf, sometimes the enrollment agent fails silently if the bootstrap token wasn't applied during imaging. try reinstalling the Jamf enrollment package from https://redwood.internal/mdm/install and reboot. i'll also check the device serial in our console.
vikram: tried reinstalling the package and rebooting, Jamf still says pending. what does attestation need exactly?
sec: attestation checks: device is MDM-enrolled, system integrity intact, and the attestation record from Jamf matches the device serial in Okta. if Jamf is pending we won't get a valid attestation blob.
idp: i removed the alias mapping and invalidated the old 1Password invite, then generated a fresh invite for vikram@redwood.com. also paused the attestation policy for your user briefly so you can complete enrollment without being blocked.
it-support: i see the device enroll request in Jamf console but it's stuck on 'Awaiting Bootstrap' for this serial. i've manually approved the enrollment and pushed the MDM profile now. give it a minute and then check System Preferences -> Profiles.
vikram: Profiles showed the Jamf MDM profile after a minute, and Jamf app says enrolled.
it-support: nice. now log out of Okta, clear browser cookies or open incognito, then try opening an app.
vikram: logged out and back in, apps now load! 1Password link worked too, onboarding vault populated. thanks. trying to register the YubiKey now...
vikram: YubiKey still fails with 'Device attestation failed: mismatch in attestation certificate' when doing WebAuthn via Chrome. Safari shows 'Registration failed: origin mismatch'.
it-support: origin mismatch often comes from a reverse proxy header or corporate browser extension rewriting origins. can you try in a private window with extensions disabled? also paste any extension names if you see them.
vikram: private window with extensions disabled in Chrome: same attestation cert mismatch. i tried on my phone using a USB-C adapter and it registered fine there.
sec: if it registers on another device, the attestation cert mismatch likely indicates the attestation blob from Jamf didn't match the one Okta expected (maybe a drift during re-enroll). i'll trigger an attestation re-eval from the identity side.
idp: re-eval kicked off at 15:12 UTC. we saw Jamf send a new attestation blob but Okta had cached the old one. cleared Okta attestation cache for your device and retried.
vikram: retried WebAuthn after cache clear and YubiKey registration succeeded in Chrome! everything looks good: apps open, Drive access ok, 1Password onboarding vault present, security key registered.
emily-manager: awesome, welcome onboard vikram! ping me for the sprint onboarding doc and i'll add you to the team channel. :coffee:
it-support: TL;DR and follow-ups: root cause was early groupsync + Jamf enrollment race plus leftover alias from migration. idp removed alias and paused strict attestation to let enrollment finish, Jamf re-pushed MDM profile, idp cleared Okta attestation cache and re-eval fixed key registration. sec will add a small delay in the provisioning pipeline to wait for MDM enrollment before enforcing attestation.
sec: noted 12; we'll add a monitoring alert to catch attestation cache mismatches and file follow-up SEC-ATT-102.
onboarding-bot: closing loop: provisioning complete for vikram. Docs for future: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/attestation-troubleshoot :book: :white_check_mark:
